verdicts.reason: Both candidates break apart the layered polaroid group. The grey mat, the white frame and the stamp circle end up side by side in a small row at the top, and the torn-paper edge becomes a floating white sliver in the middle. That destroys the design's intent and leaves no clear focal image. The headline is now the most prominent element, oversized and pushed to the bottom. A and B differ only by a few pixels of vertical spacing (B's top row sits slightly closer to the top edge, and A's text sits slightly closer to the bottom edge), so neither one is better.
